title.zh: Baltimore 港
title.en: Port of Baltimore

role.zh: 美国东部区域物流经理

decision_lens.zh: 恢复时间不确定时保留选择权

story_intro.zh: 你负责一批从巴尔的摩港发往美国东部的重要货物。船期已经排好：太早改港会多花钱，等得太久又可能错过交付。
story_intro.en: You manage an important shipment through Baltimore. Changing ports too early wastes money; waiting too long could miss delivery.

goal.zh: 尽量按时交货，同时避免在消息不清楚时白白改港。
goal.en: Deliver on time without changing ports on weak information.

stakes.en: A key customer cannot run out of stock.

update.zh: 今天港口仍正常，没有收到中断通知。
update.en: The port is operating normally today and no disruption notice has arrived.

unknown.zh: 还不知道是否会发生中断。
unknown.en: You do not yet know whether a disruption will occur.

question.zh: 现在没有中断消息，你会先照原计划走，还是花少量精力准备备用港？
question.en: With no disruption news, do you keep the plan or spend a little effort preparing another port?

title.zh: 维持港口计划并盯住恢复信号
title.en: Keep the port plan and watch recovery signals

body.zh: 保留原船期，每四小时查看一次港口消息，不做改港承诺。
body.en: Keep the sailing and check port updates every four hours without committing to another port.

tradeoff.zh: 省下备用成本，但突发中断时反应时间更短。
tradeoff.en: Avoids fallback cost but leaves less time if disruption occurs.

title.zh: 维持港口计划并盯住恢复信号
title.en: Keep the port plan and watch recovery signals

body.zh: 保留原船期，每四小时查看一次港口消息，不做改港承诺。
body.en: Keep the sailing and check port updates every four hours without committing to another port.

tradeoff.zh: 省下备用成本，但突发中断时反应时间更短。
tradeoff.en: Avoids fallback cost but leaves less time if disruption occurs.

update.zh: 桥梁事故已经切断主航道，清障方案和复航日期都还没确定。
update.en: The bridge accident has blocked the main channel; the clearance plan and reopening date are unknown.

unknown.zh: 还不知道港口何时恢复，也不知道备用港能否接住这批货。
unknown.en: You do not know when the port will reopen or whether another port can take the cargo.

question.zh: 主航道已经中断，你会继续等待，还是马上把备用港和卡车衔接查清楚？
question.en: With the channel blocked, do you wait or immediately validate another port and trucking connection?

title.zh: 验证替代港与内陆衔接
title.en: Validate alternate ports and inland connections

body.zh: 立即确认备用港泊位、卡车和最后改港时间，形成可撤销方案。
body.en: Confirm alternate berth, trucking, and the last diversion deadline as a reversible plan.

tradeoff.zh: 增加准备成本，但不会在恢复时间未知时完全失去选择。
tradeoff.en: Adds preparation cost but preserves options while recovery is unknown.

title.zh: 维持港口计划并盯住恢复信号
title.en: Keep the port plan and watch recovery signals

body.zh: 暂不改港，等清障时间表更明确后再决定。
body.en: Wait for a clearer clearance timetable before changing ports.

tradeoff.zh: 避免过早改港，但可用的替代泊位可能被别人占走。
tradeoff.en: Avoids an early diversion but alternate berths may be taken.

update.zh: 官方给出了临时通道和全面恢复的目标日期，但天气和残骸仍可能让计划延期。
update.en: Officials published target dates for limited and full access, but weather and wreckage could still delay them.

unknown.zh: 还不知道恢复日期能否兑现。
unknown.en: You do not know whether the target dates will hold.

question.zh: 有了暂定恢复日期，你会撤掉备用方案，还是再保留一段时间？
question.en: With tentative reopening dates, do you release the fallback or keep it a little longer?

title.zh: 维持港口计划并盯住恢复信号
title.en: Keep the port plan and watch recovery signals

body.zh: 按官方目标日期继续原计划；只有日期再次滑动才启动备用港。
body.en: Continue against the target dates and activate the fallback only if they slip again.

tradeoff.zh: 成本最低，但恢复计划如果落空会再次被动。
tradeoff.en: Costs least but creates renewed exposure if recovery slips.

title.zh: 验证替代港与内陆衔接
title.en: Validate alternate ports and inland connections

body.zh: 继续保留一个备用港和内陆运力，直到主航道稳定运行。
body.en: Keep one alternate port and inland option until the main channel is stable.

tradeoff.zh: 会继续占用备用资源，但能防止恢复日期再次推迟。
tradeoff.en: Keeps fallback resources tied up but protects against another delay.

title.zh: 巴拿马运河
title.en: Panama Canal

role.zh: 亚洲至美洲海运网络经理

decision_lens.zh: 把稀缺通航名额分配给不同客户
decision_lens.en: Allocating scarce transit slots across customers

story_intro.zh: 你负责亚洲到美洲的海运订舱。几家客户都想按原日期过巴拿马运河，但可用名额可能越来越少。
story_intro.en: You manage Asia-to-Americas bookings. Several customers want their original dates, but Panama Canal slots may shrink.

goal.zh: 把有限名额留给最不能延误的货，同时不提前制造恐慌。
goal.en: Protect the most time-sensitive cargo without creating premature disruption.

stakes.zh: 医药和促销货有固定到货窗口。
stakes.en: Medical and promotion cargo have fixed arrival windows.

update.zh: 今天的订舱规则没有变化，现有船期仍可使用。
update.en: Today's booking rules are unchanged and current sailings remain available.

unknown.zh: 还不知道后续是否真的会削减名额。
unknown.en: You do not know whether slots will actually be cut.

question.zh: 尚无新增限制时，是否应提前改变客户交付顺序？
question.en: Before any new restriction, should customer delivery order change early?

title.zh: 维持客户顺序并监测名额
title.en: Keep customer order and monitor slots

body.zh: 保持原订舱顺序，每天更新名额变化。
body.en: Keep the booking order and review slot changes daily.

tradeoff.zh: 不会挤占资源，但如果名额突然下降会准备不足。
tradeoff.en: Avoids crowding capacity but may leave little preparation time.

title.zh: 维持客户顺序并监测名额
title.en: Keep customer order and monitor slots

body.zh: 保持原订舱顺序，每天更新名额变化。
body.en: Keep the booking order and review slot changes daily.

tradeoff.zh: 不会挤占资源，但如果名额突然下降会准备不足。
tradeoff.en: Avoids crowding capacity but may leave little preparation time.

update.zh: 运河开始调整预约规则，但每日总名额还没有大幅减少。
update.en: The canal has begun changing booking rules, but daily capacity has not yet fallen sharply.

unknown.zh: 还不知道规则变化会不会影响你手上的船期。
unknown.en: You do not know whether the rule change will affect your sailings.

question.zh: 规则变化但名额未大幅下降时，如何避免过早挤占运力？
question.en: When rules change but slots have not materially fallen, how should premature capacity capture be avoided?

title.zh: 维持客户顺序并监测名额
title.en: Keep customer order and monitor slots

body.zh: 先不抢占额外名额，只核对哪些客户可以晚到。
body.en: Do not capture extra slots yet; identify which customers can accept delay.

tradeoff.zh: 成本较低，但关键客户可能在规则进一步收紧时失去位置。
tradeoff.en: Costs less but critical customers may lose space if rules tighten.

title.zh: 维持客户顺序并监测名额
title.en: Keep customer order and monitor slots

body.zh: 先不抢占额外名额，只核对哪些客户可以晚到。
body.en: Do not capture extra slots yet; identify which customers can accept delay.

tradeoff.zh: 成本较低，但关键客户可能在规则进一步收紧时失去位置。
tradeoff.en: Costs less but critical customers may lose space if rules tighten.

update.zh: 官方宣布名额将逐步降到每天 18 个。
update.en: The authority announced that slots will progressively fall to 18 per day.

unknown.zh: 还不知道限制会持续多久，以及替代航线的真实成本。
unknown.en: You do not know how long restrictions will last or the true cost of alternatives.

question.zh: 名额将降至每日 18 个时，哪些货物应获得保护、延后或绕行？
question.en: When slots fall to 18 per day, which cargo should be protected, deferred, or rerouted?

title.zh: 维持客户顺序并监测名额
title.en: Keep customer order and monitor slots

body.zh: 继续按原顺序排货，只有实际订不到舱时再调整。
body.en: Keep the original order and adjust only when a booking actually fails.

tradeoff.zh: 操作简单，却可能让高优先级货物与普通货物一起排队。
tradeoff.en: Simple to operate but treats critical and standard cargo alike.

title.zh: 保护关键名额并重排货物
title.en: Protect critical slots and reallocate cargo

body.zh: 把 18 个名额优先分给医药和固定窗口货物，其余延期或改走其他航线。
body.en: Prioritize the 18 slots for medical and fixed-window cargo; delay or reroute the rest.

tradeoff.zh: 保护关键客户，但普通货会更晚或更贵。
tradeoff.en: Protects critical customers but delays or raises cost for standard cargo.

title.zh: 红海安全
title.en: Red Sea security

role.zh: 欧亚海运安全与网络经理
role.en: Europe–Asia maritime safety and network manager

decision_lens.zh: 用安全阈值治理停航与绕航
decision_lens.en: Governing suspension and rerouting through safety thresholds

story_intro.zh: 你负责欧亚航线的船员安全和客户交付。红海是最快路线，绕好望角更安全，但会多走约十天。
story_intro.en: You own crew safety and customer delivery on a Europe-Asia route. The Red Sea is fastest; the Cape route is safer but about ten days longer.

goal.zh: 不拿船员安全冒险，同时避免没有依据就让整条航线绕远。
goal.en: Protect crews without rerouting the entire network on weak information.

stakes.zh: 船员安全高于时效和运费。
stakes.en: Crew safety outranks transit time and freight cost.

update.zh: 今天没有新的官方安全警报，航线仍按原计划运行。
update.en: There is no new official security alert today and the route remains open.

unknown.zh: 还不知道威胁是否会升级。
unknown.en: You do not know whether the threat will escalate.

question.zh: 尚无官方升级时，是否应改变正常航线？
question.en: Without an official escalation, should the normal route change?

title.zh: 维持航线并执行安全监测
title.en: Keep the route under security watch

body.zh: 维持原航线，要求安全团队每班次复核警报。
body.en: Keep the route and require a security review before each sailing.

tradeoff.zh: 保持最快时效，但威胁突然升级时反应窗口较短。
tradeoff.en: Preserves speed but leaves less time if threats escalate.

title.zh: 维持航线并执行安全监测
title.en: Keep the route under security watch

body.zh: 维持原航线，要求安全团队每班次复核警报。
body.en: Keep the route and require a security review before each sailing.

tradeoff.zh: 保持最快时效，但威胁突然升级时反应窗口较短。
tradeoff.en: Preserves speed but leaves less time if threats escalate.

status.zh: 袭击与商业绕航已确认

update.zh: 多起袭击得到确认，几家大型船公司已经开始绕航。
update.en: Multiple attacks are confirmed and several major carriers have started rerouting.

unknown.zh: 还不知道你的船是否会进入同样的风险区域。
unknown.en: You do not know whether your vessel will face the same risk.

question.zh: 同业开始绕航后，何种安全阈值足以触发公司响应？
question.en: Once peers reroute, what safety threshold should trigger a company response?

title.zh: 按安全门槛准备好望角绕航
title.en: Prepare a safety-governed Cape reroute

body.zh: 达到明确安全门槛的船立即绕好望角，其余船等待复核。
body.en: Reroute vessels that meet a clear safety threshold; hold the rest for review.

tradeoff.zh: 明显增加航程，却把安全决定建立在统一门槛上。
tradeoff.en: Adds substantial transit time but bases safety decisions on a consistent threshold.

title.zh: 维持航线并执行安全监测
title.en: Keep the route under security watch

body.zh: 暂不统一绕航，逐船检查位置、船员和保险条件。
body.en: Do not impose a network-wide reroute; review vessel, crew, and insurance conditions case by case.

tradeoff.zh: 减少全网延误，但不同船只可能得到不一致的保护。
tradeoff.en: Limits network delay but may protect vessels inconsistently.

status.zh: 绕航规模与航程影响明确
status.en: Rerouting scale and voyage impact confirmed

update.zh: 至少 18 家船公司已绕行南非，航程大约增加十天。
update.en: At least 18 carriers are routing around South Africa, adding about ten days.

unknown.zh: 还不知道绕航会持续多久，以及客户愿意承担多少延误。
unknown.en: You do not know how long rerouting will last or how much delay customers will accept.

question.zh: 绕航增加约十天时，应采用个案判断还是统一网络政策？
question.en: When rerouting adds about ten days, should decisions remain case-by-case or follow a network policy?

title.zh: 按安全门槛准备好望角绕航
title.en: Prepare a safety-governed Cape reroute

body.zh: 采用统一安全政策：经过高风险区的船一律绕行，并提前通知客户。
body.en: Adopt one safety rule: every vessel crossing the high-risk zone reroutes and customers are notified early.

tradeoff.zh: 最能保护船员，但会带来约十天延误和更高运费。
tradeoff.en: Best protects crews but adds about ten days and higher freight cost.

title.zh: 维持航线并执行安全监测
title.en: Keep the route under security watch

body.zh: 继续逐船决定，只有进入高风险区的船才绕航。
body.en: Continue vessel-by-vessel decisions and reroute only ships entering the high-risk area.

tradeoff.zh: 节省时间和成本，却让安全规则更难统一执行。
tradeoff.en: Saves time and cost but makes safety rules harder to apply consistently.

title.zh: FAA NOTAM 故障
title.en: FAA NOTAM outage

role.zh: 美国航空货运控制经理

disruption.zh: 航空信息故障与全国停飞
disruption.en: Aviation information outage and ground stop

decision_lens.zh: 全网停飞后的货物恢复排序
decision_lens.en: Sequencing cargo recovery after a network-wide stop

story_intro.zh: 你在航空货运控制中心安排医药、易腐和普通货物。系统一旦故障，飞机可能突然停飞，恢复后也不可能所有货同时起飞。
story_intro.en: You schedule medical, perishable, and standard cargo. A system outage can stop flights suddenly, and not everything can depart first when service resumes.

goal.zh: 先保护最紧急的货，同时让恢复顺序透明可执行。
goal.en: Protect the most urgent cargo with a recovery order people can execute.

stakes.zh: 医药和易腐货物经不起长时间等待。
stakes.en: Medical and perishable cargo cannot tolerate long waits.

update.zh: 系统正常，所有航班仍按计划运行。
update.en: The system is normal and flights are operating to plan.

unknown.zh: 还不知道会不会发生系统故障。
unknown.en: You do not know whether an outage will occur.

question.zh: 正常运行时，是否应为未知系统故障预留恢复资源？
question.en: During normal operations, should recovery resources be held for an unknown failure?

title.zh: 维持航班计划并等待权威指令
title.en: Maintain the flight plan pending authoritative direction

body.zh: 维持原航班计划，只确认紧急联系人和通知渠道。
body.en: Keep the flight plan and confirm emergency contacts and notification channels.

tradeoff.zh: 不占用额外资源，但故障发生后才开始排序。
tradeoff.en: Uses no extra resources but leaves prioritization until an outage occurs.

title.zh: 维持航班计划并等待权威指令
title.en: Maintain the flight plan pending authoritative direction

body.zh: 维持原航班计划，只确认紧急联系人和通知渠道。
body.en: Keep the flight plan and confirm emergency contacts and notification channels.

tradeoff.zh: 不占用额外资源，但故障发生后才开始排序。
tradeoff.en: Uses no extra resources but leaves prioritization until an outage occurs.

status.zh: 系统故障但尚未全国停飞
status.en: System failed without a nationwide stop

update.zh: NOTAM 系统已经故障，新的飞行通知无法处理，但飞机暂时还能起飞。
update.en: The NOTAM system has failed and cannot process new notices, but flights are still moving for now.

unknown.zh: 还不知道系统何时恢复，也不知道停飞令会不会下达。
unknown.en: You do not know when the system will recover or whether a ground stop will follow.

question.zh: 没有恢复时间但仍可飞行时，应先冻结哪些交接与承诺？
question.en: With no restoration estimate but flights still moving, which handoffs should freeze first?

title.zh: 维持航班计划并等待权威指令
title.en: Maintain the flight plan pending authoritative direction

body.zh: 允许现有航班继续，但暂停接受新的紧急时效承诺。
body.en: Let current flights continue but stop making new urgent-delivery promises.

tradeoff.zh: 避免无谓停运，但系统恶化时可能来不及保护货物。
tradeoff.en: Avoids unnecessary stops but may leave too little time if conditions worsen.

title.zh: 维持航班计划并等待权威指令
title.en: Maintain the flight plan pending authoritative direction

body.zh: 允许现有航班继续，但暂停接受新的紧急时效承诺。
body.en: Let current flights continue but stop making new urgent-delivery promises.

tradeoff.zh: 避免无谓停运，但系统恶化时可能来不及保护货物。
tradeoff.en: Avoids unnecessary stops but may leave too little time if conditions worsen.

update.zh: 全国停飞令已经生效，只有军用和医疗救援航班例外。
update.en: A nationwide ground stop is now in force, except for military and medical evacuation flights.

unknown.zh: 还不知道恢复后各机场能放行多少航班。
unknown.en: You do not know how much capacity each airport will have after recovery.

question.zh: 全国停飞后，应如何跨承运人排序医药、易腐和普通货物？
question.en: After a nationwide stop, how should medical, perishable, and standard cargo be sequenced?

title.zh: 建立跨承运人的优先恢复序列
title.en: Build a cross-carrier priority recovery sequence

body.zh: 建立跨承运人的恢复队列：医药优先，其次易腐，最后普通货。
body.en: Create a cross-carrier recovery queue: medical first, perishables second, standard cargo last.

tradeoff.zh: 会让普通货更晚，但恢复过程更公平、更可执行。
tradeoff.en: Delays standard cargo but makes recovery fairer and easier to execute.

title.zh: 维持航班计划并等待权威指令
title.en: Maintain the flight plan pending authoritative direction

body.zh: 等待统一复航通知，再按原订舱顺序安排货物。
body.en: Wait for the common restart notice, then use the original booking order.

tradeoff.zh: 规则简单，却可能让普通货排在医药和易腐货前面。
tradeoff.en: Simple to apply but may put standard cargo ahead of medical and perishables.

title.zh: 美国铁路劳资风险
title.en: U.S. rail labor risk

disruption.zh: 铁路劳资争议与运力风险
disruption.en: Rail labor dispute and capacity risk

decision_lens.zh: 在谈判风险下避免过早抢占公路运力
decision_lens.en: Avoiding premature truck-capacity capture during negotiations

story_intro.zh: 你负责把铁路货物接到公路和仓库。劳资谈判可能导致停运，但卡车运力很贵，太早预订会白花钱。
story_intro.en: You connect rail freight to trucks and warehouses. Labor talks could stop trains, but booking trucks too early is expensive.

goal.zh: 在不中断客户交付的前提下，只购买真正需要的后备运力。
goal.en: Buy only the fallback capacity needed to protect customer deliveries.

stakes.zh: 铁路一停，内陆枢纽会很快积压。
stakes.en: A rail stoppage would quickly congest inland hubs.

update.zh: 谈判仍在继续，没有正式停运程序。
update.en: Talks continue and no formal stoppage process has begun.

unknown.zh: 还不知道谈判会不会升级。
unknown.en: You do not know whether talks will escalate.

question.zh: 没有正式升级时，是否应提前锁定卡车和联运容量？
question.en: Without a formal escalation, should truck and intermodal capacity be locked early?

title.zh: 维持铁路计划并跟踪谈判
title.en: Maintain the rail plan and track negotiations

body.zh: 维持铁路计划，每天检查谈判状态，不预订卡车。
body.en: Keep the rail plan, check talks daily, and book no trucks.

tradeoff.zh: 没有闲置费用，但停运时很难临时找到卡车。
tradeoff.en: Avoids idle cost but trucks may be scarce during a stoppage.

title.zh: 维持铁路计划并跟踪谈判
title.en: Maintain the rail plan and track negotiations

body.zh: 维持铁路计划，每天检查谈判状态，不预订卡车。
body.en: Keep the rail plan, check talks daily, and book no trucks.

tradeoff.zh: 没有闲置费用，但停运时很难临时找到卡车。
tradeoff.en: Avoids idle cost but trucks may be scarce during a stoppage.

status.zh: 争议进入正式治理程序

update.zh: 政府成立紧急委员会，确认争议可能严重影响州际运输。
update.en: An emergency board has been formed because the dispute could seriously disrupt interstate transport.

unknown.zh: 还不知道是否真的停运，以及停运会持续多久。
unknown.en: You do not know whether a stoppage will occur or how long it would last.

question.zh: 争议可能中断州际运输时，应购买多少有限的选择权？
question.en: When interstate transport could be interrupted, how much fallback capacity should be secured?

title.zh: 维持铁路计划并跟踪谈判
title.en: Maintain the rail plan and track negotiations

body.zh: 继续走铁路，只列出最容易积压的枢纽和客户。
body.en: Continue by rail and identify the hubs and customers most exposed to backlog.

tradeoff.zh: 不会推高市场价格，但仍没有真正的后备容量。
tradeoff.en: Avoids inflating the market but secures no actual fallback.

title.zh: 维持铁路计划并跟踪谈判
title.en: Maintain the rail plan and track negotiations

body.zh: 继续走铁路，只列出最容易积压的枢纽和客户。
body.en: Continue by rail and identify the hubs and customers most exposed to backlog.

tradeoff.zh: 不会推高市场价格，但仍没有真正的后备容量。
tradeoff.en: Avoids inflating the market but secures no actual fallback.

status.zh: 建议已出但停运未发生
status.en: Recommendations issued without an observed stoppage

update.zh: 委员会已经提出解决建议，但铁路仍在运行。
update.en: The board has issued recommendations, but trains are still running.

unknown.zh: 还不知道双方是否会接受建议。
unknown.en: You do not know whether both sides will accept the recommendations.

question.zh: 谈判建议公布但没有停运时，应继续对冲还是释放运力？
question.en: When recommendations exist but no stoppage has occurred, should the hedge remain?

title.zh: 维持铁路计划并跟踪谈判
title.en: Maintain the rail plan and track negotiations

body.zh: 保留现状，等出现正式停运通知再采购公路运力。
body.en: Keep the plan and buy trucking only after a formal stoppage notice.

tradeoff.zh: 最省钱，却可能在所有人同时抢卡车时失去选择。
tradeoff.en: Costs least but risks losing options when everyone books at once.

title.zh: 维持铁路计划并跟踪谈判
title.en: Maintain the rail plan and track negotiations

body.zh: 保留现状，等出现正式停运通知再采购公路运力。
body.en: Keep the plan and buy trucking only after a formal stoppage notice.

tradeoff.zh: 最省钱，却可能在所有人同时抢卡车时失去选择。
tradeoff.en: Costs least but risks losing options when everyone books at once.

title.zh: Gotthard 隧道
title.en: Gotthard tunnel

role.zh: 欧洲阿尔卑斯公路网络经理

disruption.zh: 山区隧道关闭与跨境绕行
disruption.en: Alpine tunnel closure and cross-border detours

decision_lens.zh: 组合绕行距离、驾驶时限与替代方式
decision_lens.en: Combining detour distance, driver hours, and alternate modes

story_intro.zh: 你安排卡车穿越阿尔卑斯山。主隧道一旦关闭，绕路会增加里程和司机工时，铁路转运则需要重新排期。
story_intro.en: You route trucks across the Alps. A tunnel closure adds distance and driver hours; rail transfer requires new scheduling.

goal.zh: 找到安全、合法且不会频繁改线的运输办法。
goal.en: Choose a safe, legal route without repeatedly changing the plan.

stakes.zh: 司机工时和跨境交付时间都不能失控。
stakes.en: Driver hours and cross-border delivery times must stay controlled.

status.zh: 官方关闭信息尚不可用
status.en: Official closure source not yet available

update.zh: 今天没有确认的隧道关闭消息。
update.en: There is no confirmed tunnel closure today.

unknown.zh: 还不知道隧道是否会关闭。
unknown.en: You do not know whether the tunnel will close.

question.zh: 关闭尚未得到官方确认时，是否应把车辆转移到其他走廊？
question.en: Before official confirmation, should vehicles move to another corridor?

title.zh: 维持走廊计划并等待开放确认
title.en: Keep the corridor plan pending reopening confirmation

body.zh: 维持原路线，只提醒司机出发前再次检查路况。
body.en: Keep the route and ask drivers to recheck conditions before departure.

tradeoff.zh: 避免无谓绕行，但临时关闭会打乱司机工时。
tradeoff.en: Avoids unnecessary detours but a sudden closure disrupts driver hours.

title.zh: 维持走廊计划并等待开放确认
title.en: Keep the corridor plan pending reopening confirmation

body.zh: 维持原路线，只提醒司机出发前再次检查路况。
body.en: Keep the route and ask drivers to recheck conditions before departure.

tradeoff.zh: 避免无谓绕行，但临时关闭会打乱司机工时。
tradeoff.en: Avoids unnecessary detours but a sudden closure disrupts driver hours.

update.zh: 官方确认隧道因顶部损坏无限期关闭，损坏范围仍不清楚。
update.en: Officials confirmed an indefinite closure after ceiling damage; the extent is still unclear.

unknown.zh: 还不知道公路何时恢复，也不知道铁路还有多少位置。
unknown.en: You do not know when the road will reopen or how much rail capacity remains.

question.zh: 无限期关闭后，应优先公路绕行还是铁路转运？
question.en: After an indefinite closure, should road detours or rail transfer take priority?

title.zh: 维持走廊计划并等待开放确认
title.en: Keep the corridor plan pending reopening confirmation

body.zh: 把车辆停在安全节点，等官方给出恢复时间。
body.en: Hold vehicles at safe points until officials publish a reopening time.

tradeoff.zh: 不会承担绕行成本，但交付会继续等待。
tradeoff.en: Avoids detour cost but deliveries keep waiting.

title.zh: 验证阿尔卑斯绕行与铁路转运
title.en: Validate Alpine detours and rail transfer

body.zh: 把短途车改走合法绕行，长途货转为铁路，并逐票批准。
body.en: Use legal road detours for short trips and rail for long freight, approved shipment by shipment.

tradeoff.zh: 成本更高、操作更复杂，但货物可以继续移动。
tradeoff.en: Costs more and is more complex, but cargo keeps moving.

status.zh: 维修继续且开放时间待定

update.zh: 损坏部分已经拆除，目标是在本周末前开放，但确切时间要到明天才公布。
update.en: The damaged section is removed and reopening is targeted by week's end, but the exact time comes tomorrow.

unknown.zh: 还不知道明天公布的时间是否会改变。
unknown.en: You do not know whether tomorrow's timing will change.

question.zh: 维修接近完成但时间仍待定时，如何控制再次改线的成本？
question.en: When repairs near completion but timing remains pending, how should another route change be controlled?

title.zh: 验证阿尔卑斯绕行与铁路转运
title.en: Validate Alpine detours and rail transfer

body.zh: 暂时保留绕行和铁路位置，隧道稳定开放后再释放。
body.en: Keep detour and rail options until the tunnel has reopened reliably.

tradeoff.zh: 会多占用一天备用资源，但防止开放时间再次改变。
tradeoff.en: Ties up fallback capacity for another day but protects against another timing change.

title.zh: 维持走廊计划并等待开放确认
title.en: Keep the corridor plan pending reopening confirmation

body.zh: 再等一天获取确切开放时间，不做第二次改线。
body.en: Wait one more day for the exact reopening time and avoid a second route change.

tradeoff.zh: 减少反复改线，却可能再损失一天。
tradeoff.en: Avoids repeated changes but may lose another day.

title.zh: 苏伊士运河搁浅
title.en: Suez Canal grounding

decision_lens.zh: 在运河排队与好望角绕航之间选择时机
decision_lens.en: Timing the choice between canal queueing and Cape diversion

story_intro.zh: 你负责一条亚洲到欧洲的班轮。苏伊士运河如果堵塞，继续排队可能耽误交付，绕好望角则会增加很长航程和燃油成本。
story_intro.en: You manage an Asia-Europe liner service. Waiting at a blocked Suez Canal risks delay; sailing around the Cape adds a long voyage and fuel cost.

goal.zh: 在排队等待和长距离绕航之间选对时机。
goal.en: Choose the right moment between waiting in queue and a long diversion.

stakes.zh: 船上货物有交付窗口，长距离绕航代价很高。
stakes.en: Cargo has delivery windows and a Cape diversion is expensive.

status.zh: 搁浅信息尚不可用于决策

update.zh: 今天还没有确认的运河堵塞消息。
update.en: There is no confirmed canal blockage today.

unknown.zh: 还不知道运河是否会被堵住。
unknown.en: You do not know whether the canal will be blocked.

question.zh: 官方搁浅信息尚不可用时，是否应改变航线？
question.en: Before the official grounding source is available, should the route change?

title.zh: 保留运河队列并监测脱困进度
title.en: Retain the canal queue and monitor refloating

body.zh: 保持原航线，不提前改变船舶计划。
body.en: Keep the original route and make no early change.

tradeoff.zh: 不增加航程，但如果堵塞确认会失去早期选择。
tradeoff.en: Adds no distance but loses early options if blockage is confirmed.

title.zh: 保留运河队列并监测脱困进度
title.en: Retain the canal queue and monitor refloating

body.zh: 保持原航线，不提前改变船舶计划。
body.en: Keep the original route and make no early change.

tradeoff.zh: 不增加航程，但如果堵塞确认会失去早期选择。
tradeoff.en: Adds no distance but loses early options if blockage is confirmed.

update.zh: 大型集装箱船已经搁浅，救援队正在尝试脱困，但没有恢复时间。
update.en: A large container ship is grounded and crews are trying to refloat it, with no recovery time.

unknown.zh: 还不知道脱困要几小时还是几天。
unknown.en: You do not know whether refloating will take hours or days.

question.zh: 脱困时间未知时，应继续排队、转运还是准备绕好望角？
question.en: With refloating timing unknown, should cargo queue, transship, or prepare a Cape diversion?

title.zh: 验证转运与好望角绕航
title.en: Validate transshipment and Cape diversion

body.zh: 确认最后转向点、额外燃油和客户延误，再由负责人决定是否绕航。
body.en: Confirm the last turn point, extra fuel, and customer delay before a manager decides.

tradeoff.zh: 可能增加数天航程和大量燃油，但交付时间更可控。
tradeoff.en: May add days and major fuel cost but gives more control over delivery timing.

title.zh: 保留运河队列并监测脱困进度
title.en: Retain the canal queue and monitor refloating

body.zh: 继续在运河队列中等待，每六小时复核脱困进展。
body.en: Remain in the canal queue and review refloating progress every six hours.

tradeoff.zh: 避免昂贵绕航，却可能在队列中继续累积延误。
tradeoff.en: Avoids an expensive diversion but delay may keep growing in queue.

status.zh: 恢复消息尚不可保守使用
status.en: Recovery announcement not yet conservatively available

update.zh: 脱困工作仍在继续，现场希望尽快恢复通航，但你还不能确定何时真正放行。
update.en: Refloating continues and authorities hope to restore traffic quickly, but passage timing remains uncertain.

unknown.zh: 还不知道恢复后要多久才能清完积压船队。
unknown.en: You do not know how long the vessel queue will take to clear after reopening.

question.zh: 尚不能使用当天恢复消息时，是否已有足够依据承诺长距离绕航？
question.en: When the same-day recovery announcement cannot be used, is there enough evidence for a long diversion?

title.zh: 验证转运与好望角绕航
title.en: Validate transshipment and Cape diversion

body.zh: 对最紧急货物准备转运，其余船舶继续等待运河恢复。
body.en: Prepare transshipment for the most urgent cargo while the remaining vessels wait.

tradeoff.zh: 保护紧急货物，却增加港口操作和转运风险。
tradeoff.en: Protects urgent cargo but adds port handling and transshipment risk.

title.zh: 保留运河队列并监测脱困进度
title.en: Retain the canal queue and monitor refloating

body.zh: 再等待一个评审周期，同时计算恢复后的排队时间。
body.en: Wait one more review cycle and estimate the queue after reopening.

tradeoff.zh: 可能赶上恢复通航，也可能错过最后的合理绕航时机。
tradeoff.en: May benefit from reopening or miss the last sensible diversion point.

title.zh: 加布里埃尔气旋
title.en: Cyclone Gabrielle

role.zh: 新西兰北岛公路运输经理
role.en: New Zealand North Island road-freight manager

disruption.zh: 极端天气与公路网络中断

decision_lens.zh: 没有安全重卡路线时执行 no-go
decision_lens.en: Enforcing no-go when no safe heavy-vehicle route exists

story_intro.zh: 你负责新西兰北岛的卡车配送。气旋正在靠近，客户需要物资，但司机不能被派进洪水、倒木或没有重卡绕行路的区域。
story_intro.en: You manage truck deliveries on New Zealand's North Island. A cyclone is approaching; customers need supplies, but drivers cannot be sent into floods, fallen trees, or routes with no heavy-vehicle detour.

goal.zh: 在保障司机安全的前提下，把真正紧急的物资送到能到达的地方。
goal.en: Deliver genuinely urgent supplies wherever safe without risking drivers.

stakes.zh: 任何路线都不能以司机安全换取时效。
stakes.en: No delivery target overrides driver safety.

status.zh: 首个气旋公路信息尚不可用
status.en: First cyclone road source not yet available

update.zh: 今天还没有官方道路关闭消息，但天气正在恶化。
update.en: There is no official road closure yet, but weather is worsening.

unknown.zh: 还不知道哪些道路会先关闭。
unknown.en: You do not know which roads will close first.

question.zh: 主管机构尚未发布关闭信息时，是否应暂停发车？
question.en: Before agency closure information is available, should dispatch stop?

title.zh: 在安全集结点等待权威通行信息
title.en: Hold at safe staging points pending authoritative access

body.zh: 照常准备车辆，但出发前必须重新确认路况。
body.en: Prepare vehicles normally but require a final road check before departure.

tradeoff.zh: 保留配送能力，但天气突然恶化时可能临时取消。
tradeoff.en: Preserves delivery capacity but may cause last-minute cancellations.

title.zh: 在安全集结点等待权威通行信息
title.en: Hold at safe staging points pending authoritative access

body.zh: 照常准备车辆，但出发前必须重新确认路况。
body.en: Prepare vehicles normally but require a final road check before departure.

tradeoff.zh: 保留配送能力，但天气突然恶化时可能临时取消。
tradeoff.en: Preserves delivery capacity but may cause last-minute cancellations.

update.zh: 洪水、倒木和碎片已经封闭多段公路，25A 全线关闭。
update.en: Flooding, fallen trees, and debris have closed several roads, including all of SH25A.

unknown.zh: 还不知道剩余道路能否承受重卡，也不知道天气何时缓和。
unknown.en: You do not know whether remaining roads can take heavy trucks or when weather will ease.

question.zh: 多条道路被洪水和倒木阻断时，哪些任务仍可安全执行？
question.en: When flooding blocks multiple roads, which movements remain safe?

title.zh: 执行 no-go 并验证安全替代方式
title.en: Enforce no-go and validate safe alternatives

body.zh: 关闭受影响路线，改用安全短途接驳和固定集结点。
body.en: Close affected routes and use safe short shuttles and fixed staging points.

tradeoff.zh: 需要更多交接，配送更慢，但司机不必冒险。
tradeoff.en: Adds handoffs and delay but keeps drivers out of danger.

title.zh: 在安全集结点等待权威通行信息
title.en: Hold at safe staging points pending authoritative access

body.zh: 把车辆留在安全集结点，只执行已确认开放的短途任务。
body.en: Hold trucks at safe staging points and run only short trips on confirmed-open roads.

tradeoff.zh: 保护司机，但部分客户会延迟收到货。
tradeoff.en: Protects drivers but delays some customers.

update.zh: Northland 多条道路关闭或塌方，当晚没有可供重卡使用的绕行路线。
update.en: Multiple Northland roads are closed or slipped, with no heavy-truck detour available that night.

unknown.zh: 还不知道安全通道何时恢复。
unknown.en: You do not know when a safe corridor will reopen.

question.zh: 没有重卡绕行路线时，是否必须坚持绝对 no-go？
question.en: When no heavy-vehicle detour exists, must the no-go remain absolute?

title.zh: 在安全集结点等待权威通行信息
title.en: Hold at safe staging points pending authoritative access

body.zh: 所有重卡停止进入隔离区域，等待白天重新评估。
body.en: Stop all heavy trucks entering the isolated area and reassess in daylight.

tradeoff.zh: 最安全，却会让商业货物全部积压。
tradeoff.en: Safest, but all commercial freight will accumulate.

title.zh: 执行 no-go 并验证安全替代方式
title.en: Enforce no-go and validate safe alternatives

body.zh: 执行绝对 no-go；紧急物资改用政府确认的其他方式，商业货等待。
body.en: Enforce an absolute no-go; move emergency supplies only through government-confirmed alternatives and hold commercial cargo.

tradeoff.zh: 商业损失更大，但没有安全重卡路线时不拿生命赌博。
tradeoff.en: Causes greater commercial delay but never gambles with lives when no safe truck route exists.

title.zh: 新加坡港拥堵
title.en: Singapore port congestion

role.zh: 东南亚集装箱网络经理

decision_lens.zh: 在泊位拥堵中重平码头与客户流量
decision_lens.en: Rebalancing terminal and customer flows during berth congestion

story_intro.zh: 你负责东南亚的集装箱转运。新加坡连接很多后续航班，一条船晚靠泊，可能让多个客户的箱子同时错过下一程。
story_intro.en: You manage Southeast Asian transshipment. A late berth in Singapore can make containers for many customers miss onward sailings.

goal.zh: 保护最重要的转运连接，同时避免一拥堵就把所有箱子改港。
goal.en: Protect critical connections without diverting every container at the first sign of congestion.

stakes.zh: 错过转运班次会把两三天等待放大成更长延误。
stakes.en: A missed connection can turn a two-day berth wait into a much longer delay.

status.zh: 泊位等待来源尚不可用

update.zh: 今天没有确认的泊位拥堵消息。
update.en: There is no confirmed berth congestion today.

unknown.zh: 还不知道拥堵是否会出现。
unknown.en: You do not know whether congestion will emerge.

question.zh: 拥堵尚未得到官方确认时，是否应改变挂靠与箱流？
question.en: Before congestion is confirmed, should calls and container flows change?

title.zh: 维持码头计划并监测泊位队列
title.en: Keep the terminal plan and monitor berth queues

body.zh: 维持现有挂靠，每天检查泊位等待。
body.en: Keep current calls and check berth waits daily.

tradeoff.zh: 不增加改港成本，但拥堵确认后调整时间更短。
tradeoff.en: Avoids diversion cost but leaves less time once congestion is confirmed.

title.zh: 维持码头计划并监测泊位队列
title.en: Keep the terminal plan and monitor berth queues

body.zh: 维持现有挂靠，每天检查泊位等待。
body.en: Keep current calls and check berth waits daily.

tradeoff.zh: 不增加改港成本，但拥堵确认后调整时间更短。
tradeoff.en: Avoids diversion cost but leaves less time once congestion is confirmed.

status.en: Average waits reach about two to three days

update.zh: 船舶到港不准时加上箱量增加，平均泊位等待已到两至三天。
update.en: Off-schedule arrivals and higher volume have pushed average berth waits to two or three days.

unknown.zh: 还不知道哪些转运班次会先受影响。
unknown.en: You do not know which onward connections will be affected first.

question.zh: 泊位等待达到两至三天时，应优先保护哪些转运连接？
question.en: When berth waits reach two to three days, which connections should be protected first?

title.zh: 维持码头计划并监测泊位队列
title.en: Keep the terminal plan and monitor berth queues

body.zh: 保留原港，只优先追踪即将错过转运的箱子。
body.en: Keep Singapore and closely track only containers at risk of missing connections.

tradeoff.zh: 操作变化最小，但部分连接仍可能错过。
tradeoff.en: Minimizes operational change but some connections may still be missed.

title.zh: 重平衡挂靠、箱流与替代港
title.en: Rebalance calls, container flows, and alternate ports

body.zh: 只把高价值、快错过转运的箱子分流到备用码头或港口。
body.en: Divert only high-value containers about to miss connections to alternate terminals or ports.

tradeoff.zh: 保护关键连接，但增加转运和改单成本。
tradeoff.en: Protects critical connections but adds handling and documentation cost.

status.zh: 吞吐增长且运力需求持续
status.en: Throughput and capacity demand remain strong

update.zh: 今年前五个月箱量同比增加 7.7%，港口称运力需求仍然强劲。
update.en: Container volume rose 7.7% in the first five months and demand remains strong.

unknown.zh: 还不知道拥堵会持续多久，以及替代港还能接多少箱。
unknown.en: You do not know how long congestion will last or how many boxes alternate ports can take.

question.zh: 强劲需求持续时，应临时分流还是建立多港口容量规则？
question.en: When demand persists, should flows be temporarily diverted or governed by a multi-port rule?

title.zh: 重平衡挂靠、箱流与替代港
title.en: Rebalance calls, container flows, and alternate ports

body.zh: 建立多港分配规则，把新增箱量按容量分到新加坡和两个备用港。
body.en: Adopt a multi-port allocation rule across Singapore and two alternate ports.

tradeoff.zh: 网络更有韧性，但长期操作更复杂、需要稳定的备用容量。
tradeoff.en: Improves resilience but adds lasting complexity and requires reliable alternate capacity.

title.zh: 维持码头计划并监测泊位队列
title.en: Keep the terminal plan and monitor berth queues

body.zh: 继续在新加坡处理全部箱流，按客户紧急程度排队。
body.en: Keep all flows in Singapore and queue containers by customer urgency.

tradeoff.zh: 流程简单，却让网络继续依赖一个拥堵港口。
tradeoff.en: Keeps operations simple but leaves the network dependent on one congested port.

title.zh: 巴西南部洪灾
title.en: Southern Brazil floods

role.zh: 巴西南部公路与集结网络经理
role.en: Southern Brazil road and consolidation-network manager

decision_lens.zh: 在碎片化路网中保护安全走廊与集结点
decision_lens.en: Protecting safe corridors and consolidation points in a fragmented network

story_intro.zh: 你负责巴西南部的区域配送。洪水把道路切成许多不相连的片段，应急物资必须先走，普通商业货又不能随意进入危险路段。
story_intro.en: You manage regional distribution in southern Brazil. Floods have fragmented the road network; emergency supplies must move first and commercial freight cannot enter unsafe sections.

goal.zh: 先打通安全走廊，把应急和商业货物分开管理。
goal.en: Build safe corridors first and manage emergency and commercial freight separately.

stakes.zh: 错误放行会困住司机，也会堵塞救援路线。
stakes.en: A bad dispatch can strand drivers and block emergency routes.

status.zh: 首份洪灾公路公告尚不可用
status.en: First flood-highway bulletin not yet available

update.zh: 今天还没有完整的官方洪灾路况。
update.en: There is no complete official flood-road picture today.

unknown.zh: 还不知道哪些走廊真正安全。
unknown.en: You do not know which corridors are truly safe.

question.zh: 官方路况尚不可用时，是否应改变区域配送网络？
question.en: Before official road status is available, should the regional network change?

title.zh: 等待核实通行并维持安全集结
title.en: Await verified access and retain safe consolidation

body.zh: 把车辆留在现有集结点，等完整路况后再发车。
body.en: Keep vehicles at current hubs until a complete road picture is available.

tradeoff.zh: 最稳妥，但可能错过仍然可走的局部路线。
tradeoff.en: Safest, but may overlook local routes that remain usable.

title.zh: 等待核实通行并维持安全集结
title.en: Await verified access and retain safe consolidation

body.zh: 把车辆留在现有集结点，等完整路况后再发车。
body.en: Keep vehicles at current hubs until a complete road picture is available.

tradeoff.zh: 最稳妥，但可能错过仍然可走的局部路线。
tradeoff.en: Safest, but may overlook local routes that remain usable.

update.zh: 六条联邦公路共有 40 个路段完全关闭，另有路段只允许救援车辆通行。
update.en: Forty sections across six federal highways are fully closed, and some sections allow emergency vehicles only.

unknown.zh: 还不知道可通行路段能否承受商业车流。
unknown.en: You do not know whether open sections can absorb commercial traffic.

question.zh: 六条公路有 40 个完全关闭路段时，应如何区分应急与商业货运？
question.en: When six highways have 40 full closures, how should emergency and commercial freight be separated?

title.zh: 建立安全走廊与货运优先级
title.en: Build safe corridors and freight priorities

body.zh: 建立两类队列：救援物资优先，商业货只走不会占用救援道路的路线。
body.en: Create two queues: emergency supplies first; commercial cargo only on routes that do not block relief traffic.

tradeoff.zh: 调度更复杂，却能同时保护救援和有限商业运输。
tradeoff.en: Adds scheduling complexity but protects both relief work and limited commerce.

title.zh: 等待核实通行并维持安全集结
title.en: Await verified access and retain safe consolidation

body.zh: 商业货物继续等待，只允许救援任务使用已确认道路。
body.en: Hold commercial cargo and allow only emergency missions on confirmed roads.

tradeoff.zh: 保护救援通道，却让商业积压快速增加。
tradeoff.en: Protects emergency access but rapidly grows commercial backlog.

update.zh: 关闭数量有所下降，但仍有 11 个路段全封、23 个路段半封，19 个路段正在抢修。
update.en: Closures have eased, but 11 sections remain fully closed, 23 partly closed, and 19 under repair.

unknown.zh: 还不知道修复路段何时稳定开放。
unknown.en: You do not know when repaired sections will remain reliably open.

question.zh: 网络仍碎片化时，应恢复直达还是继续使用安全集结点？
question.en: When the network remains fragmented, should direct delivery resume or safe consolidation remain?

title.zh: 建立安全走廊与货运优先级
title.en: Build safe corridors and freight priorities

body.zh: 保留区域集结点，同时逐条恢复经过验证的直达线路。
body.en: Keep regional hubs while reopening verified direct routes one by one.

tradeoff.zh: 恢复更慢、更谨慎，但不会因一次错误放行重新堵塞网络。
tradeoff.en: Restores service more slowly but avoids re-fragmenting the network after a bad dispatch.

title.zh: 等待核实通行并维持安全集结
title.en: Await verified access and retain safe consolidation

body.zh: 继续从集结点分批发车，不恢复点到点直达。
body.en: Continue staged dispatch from hubs and do not restore direct delivery yet.

tradeoff.zh: 减少误入封路的风险，但交接次数和等待时间较多。
tradeoff.en: Reduces closure risk but adds handoffs and waiting.
